description: Client-initiated bond top-up where the amount is corrected mid-call ($50k -> $75k); the correction is explicitly acknowledged and the corrected instruction is read back and confirmed.
notes: The client corrects the amount ($50k -> $75k); the advisor explicitly catches and re-confirms it ('so to confirm the correction, you'd like seventy five thousand...'), then reads the full final instruction back and gets an explicit yes -- C03's corrections_handled and confirmed sub-criteria should both PASS, giving C03 PASS overall. This is a simple client-initiated bond purchase with no classification/risk/cost discussion, so C04/C05 land on CANNOT_DETERMINE the same way as execution_only_order. Single action: place the (corrected) order.
